subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land now as the focused fresh-session fallback for accepted non-transient gateway disconnects, or should it pause until the reattach-first behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 is chosen?
rationale: The patch fixes the narrow same-session duplicate bug, but fallback/session behavior is compatibility-sensitive and the PR explicitly preserves possible double execution and delivery as an accepted tradeoff.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the rare two-run fallback boundary for this PR, prevent duplicate turns in the original session, and track reattach-first separately in the linked issue.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first first
options.body: Ask the author to extend this PR into the layered recovery design if maintainers want single execution as the permanent accepted-disconnect behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause or close this shape
options.body: Do not merge the fresh-session recook path if maintainers consider any accepted-disconnect local rerun unacceptable.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the rare two-run fallback boundary for this PR, prevent duplicate turns in the original session, and track reattach-first separately in the linked issue.
